-- HU-08 T04 - construye, para cada zona (puntos_monitoreo) y la franja
-- pedida, las mismas variables que ml/data/build_dataset.py calcula para
-- entrenar: siniestros_12m, congestion_media, reportes_30d, distrito de
-- referencia. Radio de asignacion (3 km) y ventanas (12 meses, 30 dias)
-- identicos al dataset.
--
-- El parametro $1 (franja: manana|tarde|noche) ya viene validado por el
-- nodo "Validar parámetros" antes de llegar aqui.

WITH zonas AS (
  SELECT
    nombre AS zona_id,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(longitude, latitude), 4326) AS punto
  FROM puntos_monitoreo
),
siniestros_cercanos AS (
  -- Asigna cada siniestro a su zona MAS CERCANA (no "todas las zonas a
  -- <=3km"), igual que el BallTree k=1 de build_dataset.py.
  SELECT
    s.codigo_siniestro,
    s.fecha_iso,
    s.hora_siniestro,
    s.distrito,
    nz.zona_id,
    nz.dist_m
  FROM siniestros_fatales s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT z.zona_id,
           ST_Distance(s.geom::geography, z.punto::geography) AS dist_m
    FROM zonas z
    ORDER BY s.geom <-> z.punto
    LIMIT 1
  ) nz
  WHERE s.geom IS NOT NULL
    AND s.departamento = 'LIMA'
    AND nz.dist_m <= 3000
),
siniestros_12m AS (
  SELECT zona_id, count(*) AS siniestros_12m
  FROM siniestros_cercanos
    WHERE fecha_iso >  (SELECT max(fecha_iso) FROM siniestros_fatales) - INTERVAL '365 days'
    AND fecha_iso <= (SELECT max(fecha_iso) FROM siniestros_fatales)
    AND (
      ($1 = 'manana' AND split_part(hora_siniestro, ':', 1)::int BETWEEN 6 AND 11)
      OR ($1 = 'tarde' AND split_part(hora_siniestro, ':', 1)::int BETWEEN 12 AND 17)
      OR ($1 = 'noche' AND (split_part(hora_siniestro, ':', 1)::int >= 18 OR split_part(hora_siniestro, ':', 1)::int < 6))
    )
  GROUP BY zona_id
),
distrito_frecuente AS (
  -- Moda del distrito entre TODOS los siniestros asignados a la zona (no
  -- solo los de la franja pedida), igual criterio que build_dataset.py.
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (zona_id) zona_id, distrito
  FROM (
    SELECT zona_id, distrito, count(*) AS cnt
    FROM siniestros_cercanos
    WHERE distrito IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY zona_id, distrito
  ) t
  ORDER BY zona_id, cnt DESC
),
reportes_cercanos AS (
  SELECT
    r.id,
    r.created_at,
    nz.zona_id,
    nz.dist_m
  FROM reports r
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT z.zona_id,
           ST_Distance(
             ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(r.longitude, r.latitude), 4326)::geography,
             z.punto::geography
           ) AS dist_m
    FROM zonas z
    ORDER BY ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(r.longitude, r.latitude), 4326) <-> z.punto
    LIMIT 1
  ) nz
  WHERE r.latitude IS NOT NULL AND r.longitude IS NOT NULL
    AND nz.dist_m <= 3000
),
reportes_30d AS (
  SELECT zona_id, count(*) AS reportes_30d
  FROM reportes_cercanos
  WHERE created_at >= (now() - INTERVAL '30 days')
  GROUP BY zona_id
),
congestion AS (
  -- Misma logica que build_dataset.py: promedio historico completo de
  -- traffic_readings por zona x franja (hora en UTC), sin ventana de tiempo.
  SELECT
    punto_nombre AS zona_id,
    avg(porcentaje_congestion) AS congestion_media
  FROM traffic_readings
  WHERE porcentaje_congestion IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      ($1 = 'manana' AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (captured_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) BETWEEN 6 AND 11)
      OR ($1 = 'tarde' AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (captured_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) BETWEEN 12 AND 17)
      OR ($1 = 'noche' AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (captured_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) >= 18 OR EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (captured_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) < 6))
    )
  GROUP BY punto_nombre
)
SELECT
  z.zona_id,
  z.latitude,
  z.longitude,
  df.distrito,
  COALESCE(s12.siniestros_12m, 0)::int AS siniestros_12m,
  COALESCE(r30.reportes_30d, 0)::int AS reportes_30d,
  COALESCE(round(c.congestion_media::numeric, 2), 0) AS congestion_media
FROM zonas z
LEFT JOIN siniestros_12m s12 ON s12.zona_id = z.zona_id
LEFT JOIN reportes_30d r30 ON r30.zona_id = z.zona_id
LEFT JOIN congestion c ON c.zona_id = z.zona_id
LEFT JOIN distrito_frecuente df ON df.zona_id = z.zona_id
ORDER BY z.zona_id;

SELECT 1 AS ok,
       m.tipo,
       m.fecha,
       m.datos
FROM (SELECT 1) AS ping
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT tipo, fecha, datos
  FROM eventos
  WHERE tipo IN ('modelo.monitoreado', 'modelo.deriva_detectada')
  ORDER BY fecha DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS m ON true;

INSERT INTO cache_riesgo_predictivo (franja, dia, payload, generado_en)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, now())
ON CONFLICT (franja) DO UPDATE SET
  dia = EXCLUDED.dia,
  payload = EXCLUDED.payload,
  generado_en = EXCLUDED.generado_en;
